correct_query: SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND NOT name IN (SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2000);

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant compares circuitId instead of name in NOT IN subquery predicate
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT r.name FROM races AS r WHERE r.year = 2017 AND NOT r.circuitId IN (SELECT r2.circuitId FROM races AS r2 WHERE r2.year = 2000);
